name: InkJournal
description: A daily journaling app for iPhone with AI-generated writing prompts and a private mood tracker. Users write short entries each day; InkJournal analyzes tone and word choice on-device to plot a weekly mood trend graph and suggests a personalized prompt for the next entry based on recent patterns.
key_features: AI-generated daily journaling prompts based on recent entries
On-device mood scoring from journal text
Weekly mood trend graph with correlations to sleep and activity (via HealthKit)
Private, exportable journal archive

name: SnapMeasure
description: An AR-based measuring app that lets users scan a room or object with the camera and get accurate dimensions, plus export the scan for use in CAD or interior design tools. Popular with contractors and DIY renovators.
key_features: Single-room AR scanning with dimension overlay
Multi-room scan stitching for whole-apartment floor plans
Export to USDZ and CSV for use in CAD tools
Object volume estimation

name: FocusFlow
description: A productivity app that blocks distracting apps and websites during user-defined work sessions, with a 'distraction budget' that allows a limited number of minutes per session before hard-blocking.
key_features: Custom work session presets with per-app time budgets
Hard blocking of distracting apps once budget is exceeded
Session history and weekly distraction reports
Adapts app-specific settings automatically when a session starts

name: QuietRead
description: A minimalist RSS and read-later app with offline sync, custom reading themes, and a distraction-free article view. No AI features, no social feed, no OS-level integration beyond standard share sheet support.
key_features: RSS feed subscriptions with offline sync
Read-later queue with iCloud sync across devices
Custom fonts and reading themes
Distraction-free article reader view

name: TableTally
description: A restaurant bill-splitting and tip calculator app. Users photograph or manually enter a receipt, assign items to people, and TableTally computes each person's share including tax and tip.
key_features: Manual and photo-based receipt entry
Per-item assignment to multiple people
Configurable tip and tax splitting rules
Shareable summary via Messages
